audit.why: Magic-damage tank who farms safely with Winds of War (Q). Lane is Aatrox's, but Shield of Durand (W) taunt turns any careless all-in around.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 phase text was a generic template that named no ultimate and no cooldown.
audit.why: Hero's Entrance (R) is 180/160/140 and is a map tool, not a duel button — his real level-6 threat stays the W taunt. World Ender at 120/100/80 comes up far more often than his R.
audit.corrected: Hero's Entrance (R) is 180s and usually leaves lane — his real threat stays Shield of Durand (W, 18s) taunt. Bait it, then World Ender turns the extended fight yours.

audit.whatIsWrong: Key Ability Interactions described Infernal Chains (W) as a root; Riot’s text says enemies are dragged back to the centre if they do not leave the zone, and the decisive interaction for this matchup was absent.
audit.why: Shield of Durand (W, 18/17/16/15/14) taunts, which overrides your inputs mid-combo; Justice Punch (E, 11/10/9/8/7) is a dash that knocks up the first champion hit — Infernal Chains grounds it if you land W first.
audit.corrected: Your Q sweetspot (outer edge) is your damage and your heal — land the edge, never the inner hit, and use E mid-cast to swing the sweetspot onto Galio. Infernal Chains (W) drags him back to the centre if he stays in the zone, and it grounds — land it and Justice Punch (E, 11s at rank 1) is dead. Shield of Durand (W, 18s) taunts through your combo, so bait the charge before you commit. Save World Ender for the fight, not a single Q.

edits.before: Ultimate interaction changes all-ins. At level 6, reassess the matchup. Aatrox gains his ultimate, but Galio's ultimate or scaling pattern may change whether you can commit.
edits.after: Hero's Entrance (R) is 180s and usually leaves lane — his real threat stays Shield of Durand (W, 18s) taunt. Bait it, then World Ender turns the extended fight yours.

Pop R (World Ender) for the heal, AD and move speed when you fully commit or to survive his ultimate — never burn it for a single Q.
